# sherpa-tag

A compact labelled pill. Colour comes from the [data-status] cascade on an ancestor, not from the tag itself.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | control |
| Figma | Tag |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-tag/sherpa-tag.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-tag/sherpa-tag.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-tag/sherpa-tag.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-tag/sherpa-tag.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-tag/sherpa-tag.example.json) |

## When to use it

To mark a thing with a short label and a status colour; `data-type="dot"` is a small circle. For a count, use `sherpa-badge`; for a selection or filter token, use `sherpa-chip`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-tag>Draft</sherpa-tag>
<sherpa-tag data-status="critical" data-dismissible>Overdue</sherpa-tag>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-dismissible` | boolean | `false` | show the close button (fires tag-dismiss) |
| `data-icon` | text |  | leading icon glyph value (shown when present; or slot "icon") |
| `data-status` | `info` `success` `warning` `critical` `urgent` |  | info \| success \| warning \| critical \| urgent (via the cascade) |
| `data-type` | `dot` |  | dot (render as a small circular indicator; default full) |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail |
|---|---|
| `tag-dismiss` |  |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `icon` | icon | a leading glyph (overrides data-icon; shown when data-icon is set) |
| (default) | text | the label |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`close`, `icon`, `pill`
